headword: {頭|あたま}{隠|かく}して{尻|しり}{隠|かく}さず
reading: あたまかくしてしりかくさず
gloss: hiding one's head but leaving one's rear exposed

definitions.gloss: a poorly hidden fault; covering up only part of the evidence
definitions.explanation: Literally "hiding the head but not the rear", from the image of a pheasant that pokes its head into the grass and thinks it is hidden. Said of someone who hides one part of a fault or secret while the rest is in plain view.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧じゃ{頭|あたま}{隠|かく}して{尻|しり}{隠|かく}さずだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: That's like hiding your head and leaving your tail sticking out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{頭|あたま}{隠|かく}して{尻|しり}{隠|かく}さずだった。
examples.english: He thought he had destroyed the evidence, but he had only covered half his tracks.

examples.japanese: ⟦つまみ{食|ぐ}い→つまみ食い：27222_tsumamigui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}そう→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧とした⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧チョコ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{頭|あたま}{隠|かく}して{尻|しり}{隠|かく}さずだった。
examples.english: My little brother tried to hide that he'd been snacking, but he had chocolate on his mouth — a perfect case of a badly hidden secret.

notes:
Usually said with amusement about a clumsy cover-up, often of children or of someone caught in an obvious lie.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{頭|あたま}{隠|かく}して{尻|しり}{隠|かく}さずだ: it's a classic case of a badly hidden secret

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隠|かく}し{事|ごと}→隠し事：15776_kakushigoto⟧: a secret one is keeping
- ⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: to be found out
